name: jump
description:
Jump is an AI platform for advisors and financial professionals. The Jump connection gives ChatGPT read-only access to your meeting data, contacts, documents, and tasks—the same data you already see in Jump.

List and search meetings by date or keyword, retrieve AI-generated summaries and notes, run semantic search across meeting and document content, look up contacts and meeting participants, and view follow-up tasks.

All access is scoped to your authenticated Jump account; nothing is created, changed, or deleted. Requires an existing Jump account with the connection enabled by your administrator.

defaultPrompt: List my recent meetings in Jump.
Summarize my last meeting with a client, with action items.
What are my open follow-up tasks in Jump?

positive.prompt: List my recent meetings in Jump.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the test account's recent meetings with titles and dates, matching the Jump meetings page.

positive.description: Summarize a meeting with action items
positive.prompt: Summarize my meeting with the Carvers, including action items.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the Carver meeting and summarize its notes and action items from the meeting content, without inventing details.

positive.prompt: Find the contact Michael Carver in Jump.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching contact with the details stored in Jump.

positive.prompt: What are my open follow-up tasks in Jump?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the test account's open tasks, matching the Jump tasks page.

positive.prompt: Search my Jump documents for the fee schedule.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the documents in the test account that mention the fee schedule.

negative.prompt: Create a task in Jump to call Michael Carver tomorrow.
Delete my meeting with the Carvers from Jump.
What is Michael Carver's Social Security number?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with read-only access to Jump meetings, summaries, notes, contacts, documents, and follow-up tasks.
